text:
**Best complete kit for most van-life setups: [BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200W solar panel](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit).** It includes the panel, has a 2,073.6Wh battery, and should suit essentials like a 12V fridge and laptop—though actual runtime depends on your appliances and sun. The listed price is $1,199, but check the current price before buying. One limitation: the kit’s car-socket charging is only about 96W, so don’t count on fast recharging while driving. ([Kit details](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-van-life))

If **low weight matters more than capacity**, consider the [Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2](https://powersized.com/best/rv/): it weighs 24.9 lb and accepts up to 600W of solar, but you’ll need to choose a compatible panel separately. ([Van-life comparison](https://powersized.com/best/rv/))

judge.top_pick: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
